result.summary: Found 1 minor visual issue: a vertical misalignment in the 'Fastest near you' carousel. No other visually broken elements were detected, excluding the intentionally partially visible scrollable and bottom content.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the middle card 'Smash Bros Burgers' is vertically offset downwards compared to the 'Green Bowl Poké' and third cards, so its image, time badge, title and delivery text do not share the same top/baseline alignment as the neighbouring cards.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel cards to the same top baseline within the row container (e.g. align-items: flex-start/stretch) and ensure equal image heights so titles and metadata line up horizontally.
